controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim against page 298 (Rule 10.07(1)(i)); holders (Controlling Shareholders: Hisense Group Holding and CKL) confirmed via pp.18/22. However, the wording is 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' — the anniversary (2027-03-22) is INCLUSIVE as the stated end date, so it is the last restricted day and the first free day is anniversary + 1. This matches the task convention ('ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' → anniversary inclusive → first free day = anniversary + 1) and the reviewed 0470.HK entry (listing 2026-02-11: last_restricted_day=2026-08-11, first_free_day=2026-08-12). The candidate applied the cornerstone-style convention to this block, shifting both dates one day early. Note 3 to Rule 10.07(2) 12-month pledge-notification undertaking is correctly cited as being on the same page 298.
